semantic_description: This diagram illustrates the architecture of a Multi-Head Attention mechanism, a key component in transformer models used in natural language processing and machine learning. It shows how the mechanism processes input vectors (V, K, Q) through linear transformations and then combines the results using scaled dot-product attention. The output is then concatenated and fed into another linear transformation.
